_readme: The distractions on the Wheel of Distraction board in the Left Brain, Meet Mr Right chapter, with the board's own wording, read from the book's artwork (source/artwork/DISTRACTION A:W.ai) on 2026-11-07. The board has 16 spaces. Three are left out on purpose for a workplace site: the vodka martini, looking at yourself naked in the mirror, and the sexy phone conversation. The building-blocks space says 'LEGO' on the board; the brand is dropped here. Mark reviews, including whether to put any of these back.

distractions.title: Do a crossword puzzle
distractions.aside: It could also be Sudoku, bless you!

distractions.title: Mend something around the house
distractions.aside: You know, that wobbly chair or that faulty trepanning drill.

distractions.title: Visit an art gallery
distractions.aside: Walk around and ponder the exhibits while rubbing your, or somebody else's, chin thoughtfully.

distractions.title: Do some high energy exercise
distractions.aside: Up to you what, but please bring a towel.

distractions.title: Go on a bus ride
distractions.aside: The number 142 is always a pleasant trip.

distractions.title: Play a game of chess or checkers
Build something out of building blocks
Do some cooking
distractions.aside: We'll be around at about seven.

distractions.title: Go for a gentle bike ride or walk
Take a bath
distractions.aside: Or if you're trying to save some water or time, take a shower. Don't forget to wash behind the ears.

distractions.title: Listen, really listen, to some classical music or jazz
